comment.en: Relates an individual measurement or test result to the individual product property, observed degradation phenomenon, failure mode, or external damage that the result directly concerns. This relation identifies the subject of the result, not necessarily the specific quantity, degree, or grading dimension measured. Its intended object is not a test-protocol parameter, result value, assessment criterion, derived indicator, or OWL class used as an individual. A result's method and interpretation scale, when relevant, determine how the reported value is to be interpreted.
